# mtncloud_load_balancer_l7_policies (Data Source)

Lists the L7 policies of one listener, in the order they are tried, each with its rules. Pick the load balancer and the listener by ID or name.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "mtncloud_network" "app" {
  name = "app-net"
}

data "mtncloud_load_balancer_l7_policies" "http" {
  network_id         = data.mtncloud_network.app.id
  load_balancer_name = "web-lb"
  listener_name      = "http"
}

output "policies" {
  value = [for p in data.mtncloud_load_balancer_l7_policies.http.l7_policies : "${p.position}: ${p.action}"]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `network_id` (Number) ID of the MTN Network the load balancer is on, for example `mtncloud_network.app.id`. Your tenant must own the network or have it shared with it.

### Optional

- `listener_id` (String) The listener's ID. Give this or `listener_name`.
- `listener_name` (String) The listener's name, matched exactly. Give this or `listener_id`.
- `load_balancer_id` (String) Load balancer ID. Give this or `load_balancer_name`.
- `load_balancer_name` (String) Load balancer name, matched exactly; it must match exactly one on the network. Give this or `load_balancer_id`.

### Read-Only

- `l7_policies` (Attributes List) The listener's L7 policies, by position. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--l7_policies))

<a id="nestedatt--l7_policies"></a>
### Nested Schema for `l7_policies`

Read-Only:

- `action` (String) `REDIRECT_TO_POOL`, `REDIRECT_TO_URL`, `REDIRECT_PREFIX` or `REJECT`.
- `description` (String) Description, or empty.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether it is administratively up.
- `id` (String) L7 policy ID.
- `name` (String) Policy name, or empty.
- `operating_status` (String) `ONLINE`, `OFFLINE`, `DEGRADED`, `ERROR` or `NO_MONITOR`.
- `position` (Number) Its place in the listener's order, from 1.
- `provisioning_status` (String) `ACTIVE`, or `PENDING_CREATE`, `PENDING_UPDATE`, `PENDING_DELETE` while a change is applied, or `ERROR`.
- `redirect_http_code` (Number) For redirects: the status code, or 0.
- `redirect_pool_id` (String) For `REDIRECT_TO_POOL`: the pool's ID, or empty.
- `redirect_prefix` (String) For `REDIRECT_PREFIX`: the start of the new address, or empty.
- `redirect_url` (String) For `REDIRECT_TO_URL`: where it redirects, or empty.
- `rules` (Attributes List) The conditions a request must all meet, sorted by type and value. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--l7_policies--rules))

<a id="nestedatt--l7_policies--rules"></a>
### Nested Schema for `l7_policies.rules`

Read-Only:

- `compare_type` (String) `EQUAL_TO`, `STARTS_WITH`, `ENDS_WITH`, `CONTAINS` or `REGEX`.
- `invert` (Boolean) Whether it matches when the comparison fails.
- `key` (String) The header or cookie name for `HEADER` and `COOKIE` rules, or empty.
- `type` (String) What is compared, for example `PATH` or `HOST_NAME`.
- `value` (String) The value compared with.
